text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen finish their run together…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew, that felt great! I feel like I can do another lap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed … Your final sprint before the finish line was quite splendid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The power you displayed showed me your desire to never be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho, really?! Thanks! It psychs me up to hear you say that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I can’t look like a fool in front of the people who believe in me. Know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whenever I think of that, energy comes surging into my body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I believe I do know what you're saying…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You wanted to show off in front of your trainer and pushed yourself extra hard, correct? How cute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Say what?! H-hey, it's not like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My trainer's always got my back, so I just wanna return the favor is all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh, so… Yeah! All that running is really making me feel the burn!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Goodness… Hehe, though I must admit… I am a little envious.
